name: job-collector-brand-linear
label: JobCollector 品牌线性图标
preamble: A restrained technical-document icon: one open white collection box with a black outline, the visible label JOBox, and one blue downward flow arrow. Flat front-facing geometry, clear structure, no outer app tile, no decorative flourish, no texture, no gradient, and no shadow.

construction.grid: 32-unit keyline; 26-unit live area; 3-unit safe padding; optical centering for both 16px toolbar and 128px store use
construction.stroke: 2 units for the open box and directional arrow on a 32-unit grid; rounded caps and joins
construction.corner_radius: 3-unit lower box corners and fully rounded open terminals
construction.angles: orthogonal geometry; the arrow uses only 45-degree diagonals
construction.detail_budget: one core idea with three parts: open collection box, JOBox label, incoming arrow
construction.fill_rule: pure-white flat fills with near-black outlines; no tonal or decorative fills
construction.color_rule: near-black carries the silhouette; blue appears only on the small incoming arrow and stays visually subordinate
construction.shared_parts: reuse the same rounded terminal and lower-corner geometry throughout
construction.motif: a blue downward arrow entering an open box labeled JOBox, expressing collection through direction rather than decoration
construction.weight_hierarchy: the near-black briefcase silhouette remains heaviest; the blue arrow is smaller and occupies less area

fits: Chrome extension toolbar icon, extension package icon, and 128x128 Chrome Web Store icon.
notes: The SVG master semantically distills the approved docs/design/job-collector-icon-source.png reference. All shipped PNG sizes are rendered from the 128px SVG master. The reusable generation prompt is docs/design/job-collector.prompt.md. Derived from docs/design/STYLE_DNA.md.
